content: Never use JS float for money. Two standard approaches: (1) store/transact in integer minor units (cents), or (2) treat amount as a decimal string end-to-end and only convert to Number at the final display step via Intl.NumberFormat, never for arithmetic. This project already applies pattern (2) end to end: Prisma Decimal(12,2) serialized as a JSON string, API regex-validated (/^\d{1,10}(\.\d{1,2})?$/), and formatMoney() converts to Number only for Intl.NumberFormat display. Client-side forms should preserve this: capture amount as text/string, validate against the same shape client-side, and never round-trip through parseFloat for anything but display.
